invariants.rationale: The method implementation returns the input list directly, so the result is exactly the same object as records.
Since result and records are the same object, their sizes must be equal.
Partition parameters for collections are typically non-negative; negative partition counts are not meaningful.
The method always returns the (non-null) input records list, so result is never null.
The method immediately returns 'records', so it must not be null at exit.
